title: YADEX-Yet AnotherDEX
tagline: Yet Another Decentralized Exchange where users can trade single pair (only for now) for Mantle, Linea, zkEVM
description: Yet Another Decentralized Exchange (YADEX) is poised to make waves in the crypto space with its deployment across various testnets. By choosing Polygon zkEVM testnet, YADEX demonstrates its commitment to scalability and low-cost transactions, leveraging Polygon's layer 2 solutions for enhanced performance. The integration with Mantle testnet showcases YADEX's dedication to security, as Mantle is known for its robust testing environment, ensuring a resilient and reliable decentralized exchange platform. Additionally, YADEX's presence on Linea Testnet highlights its adaptability and with Scroll's interoperability, it makes life easier, tapping into diverse ecosystems to provide users with a seamless and comprehensive trading experience across different blockchain networks. The strategic deployment across these tenets positions YADEX as a promising player in the evolving landscape of decentralized exchanges.
how_its_made:
I utilized the Scaffold-Eth2 boilerplate which already includes frontend components and smart contract helper functions. The only challenge was to finalize the smart contract development properly to facilitate the constant product formula of Uniswap's earlier versions with %0.3 trading fee.

While keeping enough liquidity in the pools, users can trade single-pair tokens. For now.
